ingame_enable.name: Enable debug tools
ingame_enable.description:
Allows you to enable and disable Bismuth while playing by pressing F8. It also allows you to use Difference Mode by pressing F9 (Difference Mode is very unstable).

 WARNING: This option effectively removes any optimization.

glow_strength.name: Glow strength
glow_strength.description: How strong the glow of objects is drawn. 1 is the full strength, lower values tone it down. Takes effect the next time a level is loaded.

show_runtime_objects.name: Show objects created while playing
show_runtime_objects.description: Practice mode checkpoints (and anything else the game creates after the level loaded) are moved out of the game's hidden batch nodes so they are visible.

hide_high_detail_in_ldm.name: Hide high detail objects in Low Detail Mode
hide_high_detail_in_ldm.description: Like the game, skip objects marked High Detail while Low Detail Mode is on. Takes effect the next time a level is loaded.

scale_triggers.name: Scale / transform triggers
scale_triggers.description: Makes scale and transform triggers (scale, skew, only move, center group) show up in the rendering. Next level load.

debug_keep_optimizations.name: Keep optimizations with debug tools
debug_keep_optimizations.description: Debug tools normally switch the CPU optimizations off. Turn this on to measure the real thing: the log gets a [perf] line every 2 seconds. Do not use F8 while this is on. Next level load.

particle_update_hz.name: Particle update rate
particle_update_hz.description: How many times per second the game's particle update (needed for fog and smoke) runs. 0 runs it every frame. Lower values save CPU time. Takes effect the next time a level is loaded.

vis_particles.name: Fog fix: update game particles
vis_particles.description: Runs the game's particle update that the optimized visibility path used to skip. Next level load.

vis_pre_update.name: Fog test: run preUpdateVisibility
vis_pre_update.description: Test switch. Also runs the game's pre-visibility step. Next level load.

vis_enter_area.name: Fog test: run enter and area effect updates
vis_enter_area.description: Test switch. Also runs updateEnterEffects and processAreaVisualActions. Next level load.

opt_visibility.name: Fog test: skip game visibility update
opt_visibility.description: Test switch. Turn OFF to let the game run its own per-object visibility update. Only used while debug tools are off. Next level load.

opt_rotation.name: Fog test: optimized rotation
opt_rotation.description: Test switch. Turn OFF to use the slower rotation path. Only used while debug tools are off. Next level load.

opt_move.name: Fog test: skip CPU move of optimized groups
opt_move.description: Test switch. Turn OFF to let the game also move optimized groups on the CPU. Only used while debug tools are off. Next level load.

opt_deco_removal.name: Fog test: remove decoration from move groups
opt_deco_removal.description: Test switch. Turn OFF to keep decoration objects in the game's move groups. Only used while debug tools are off. Next level load.

use_mapped_buffers.name: Upload buffers through mapping
use_mapped_buffers.description: Uploads the per-frame buffers by mapping them instead of using glBufferSubData. May work well with integrated GPUs, not so much with discrete GPUs (like a graphics card)
